task.title: Permanently deleting an image tag using the Red Hat Quay v2 UI
task.shortdesc: To permanently delete an image tag in Red Hat Quay by using the v2 UI, you can select the tag in a repository and choose Permanently Delete.

ul.li: You have set FEATURE_UI_V2 to true in your config.yaml file.

step.cmd: Ensure that the PERMANENTLY_DELETE_TAGS and RESET_CHILD_MANIFEST_EXPIRATION parameters are set to true in your config.yaml file. For example:
In the navigation pane, click Repositories.
Click the name of the repository, for example, quayadmin/busybox.
Select the check box of the image tag that you want to delete, for example, test.

note.p: This action is permanent and cannot be undone.
